speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) to date, how many inmates have been enrolled in the Employment Preparation Scheme; and (b) of which, what is the number of such inmates who were granted (i) weekend home leave and (ii) long home leave and (iii) secured permanent employment upon release from detention.

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim (Nominated Member)
text: Basically, I wanted to check if we can do more to increase the numbers and whether there is any form of case management given, in view of the recent data that was released to highlight that recidivism rate has gone up for certain population of inmates.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, I want to assure the Member, wherever possible, we will do more.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We are also looking at how we want not only to support the inmates, but also their families.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, this would involve much coordinated work with SSAs, economic agencies as well as companies, to see how we can support the inmates and their families holistically.
